A '''''Gozanti''-class cruiser''' belonged to the [[Advanced Science Division]] and commanded by [[Captain]] [[Pearce]]<ref name="Tipping Point" /> was used during or after [[18 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|214}}</ref> to transport [[Howzer]] and two of his troops from [[Balmorra]] to [[Tantiss Base]] on [[Mount Tantiss]]. Before it could jump to [[hyperspace]], it was attacked by a [[Remora|gunship]] piloted by [[Echo]] and [[Gregor]] who destroyed its engines and boarded the [[starship|ship]] using a [[leech vessel]], successfully defeating its security and rescuing the [[prisoner]]s. The starship was subsequently destroyed by [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]] sent from a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], intending to erase all evidence of its existence, prompting the boarders to escape to their own ship and leave the system.<ref name="Tipping Point" />
